title: 20-Year-Old Goes Nuts And Vandalizes A Pet Clinic
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 16th, 2023. Officers received a call regarding a 20-year-old who randomly walked into a pet clinic and just threw one of their computers on the floor, the suspect walked out of the clinic however the employees quickly locked the door but then when he returned, the started smashing and breaking the locked door. He also started beating and vandalizing one of the customers car. It was unsure what the man’s motive was but it was clear he was not in a good mental state. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
